changes.why: CR-PBI002-01: sessionLive(s, now = Date.now()); isLive(now) and scopeLive(now) pass it through. renderHeader(now = renderNow). The Other-sessions 'Running now' tile (sessionLive(s, renderNow)), the Pipeline legend (isLive(renderNow)) and the Dispatch 'Running now' tile (scopeLive(renderNow)) use the render's one reading. clockState(now) passes now to isLive and scopeLive. The minute timer reads Date.now() once and uses it for renderHeader(now) and clockState(now). The clockState comment now says why a second reading is wrong. CR-PBI002-02: usageChart maps each kept hour to { hour, main: Number(h.main) || 0, sub: Number(h.sub) || 0 } (niceCeil(0) is 1, so an all-zero series draws an empty axis, not 0/0). Block 11: the usage.hourly loop also asserts no NaN on the Overview and usage tabs, and a new check covers hours whose main/sub are missing or not numbers. Block 12: a helper endsWhileDrawn(e, panel, end) replaces the panel's innerHTML with an accessor pair so that every clock reading before that panel is drawn is 1 ms before the window ends and every one after is 1 ms past it. Two checks use it: the Other-sessions Overview and the Dispatch tile under a project session filter. Block 14: a pipeline-motion check.
